page.overview:
What is Spybotics?

Spybotics is a TECHNIC theme in which you complete and/or create various missions. You can program the missions onto the spybot using a cable. Four Spybotics sets and one watch have been made in the series. It was a short-lived theme only lasting one year - 2002.
